translations.web: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”
translations.bsb: They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”
translations.kjv: And they said among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the sepulchre?
translations.asv: And they were saying among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb?
